MeasureSpecs where Asuncion is 250 miles due east of Pingeling, and Ceiba is due east of both Asuncion and Pongeling. María proudly collects wild flowers, many of which grow exclusively along the edges of streams, the paths of a river, and along the Himalaya mountain range. María visiting Asuncion she drops three flowers in stream, runs along a ridge, stops to collect them once again, then takes the flowers upon reaching Ceiba to pay for an accounting book. Which two flowers do María re-acquire on her journey to Ceiba after she stops to collect wild flowers?
